title: Jonah Ran the Wrong Way
author: QUILL
notes: Tarshish shown as two dashed candidates. 'Great fish' (Hebrew dag gadol) not 'whale'. Nebi Yunus 2014 destruction is real. Not-proven line in beat 10.

beats.text: Jonah ran from God, in exactly the wrong direction.
God sends him east to Nineveh, but he boards a ship at Joppa.
beats.say: God sends him east to NIN-eh-vuh, but he boards a ship at JOP-ah.

beats.text: The ship's destination: Tarshish, maybe Tartessos in Spain, maybe Tarsus in Turkey.
beats.say: The ship's destination: TAR-shish, maybe tar-TESS-os in Spain, maybe TAR-sus in Turkey.

beats.text: A storm hits, and the sailors cast lots. The lot falls on Jonah.
beats.label: STORM AT SEA

beats.text: In Hebrew, the creature is a 'great fish,' not a whale.
beats.say: In Hebrew, the creature is a DAHG gah-DOLE, a great fish, not a whale.

beats.text: It swallows him for three days and three nights.
beats.label: GREAT FISH

beats.text: Freed, he reaches Nineveh, a city 'three days' journey' across.
beats.say: Freed, he reaches NIN-eh-vuh, a city three days' journey across.

beats.text: His warning: forty days, and Nineveh falls.
beats.say: His warning: forty days, and NIN-eh-vuh falls.

beats.text: The whole city repents, even the king.
beats.label: NINEVEH REPENTS

beats.text: Plainly: no Assyrian record mentions Jonah's mission.
beats.say: Plainly: no Assyrian record mentions JOE-nah's mission.

beats.text: In Mosul, atop ancient Nineveh, the Nebi Yunus shrine marked Jonah's traditional tomb.
beats.say: In Mosul, atop ancient NIN-eh-vuh, the NEB-ee YOO-nus shrine marked Jonah's traditional tomb.

beats.text: ISIS blew it up in 2014, and Assyrian remains were later found beneath.
beats.say: EYE-sis blew it up in 2014, and Assyrian remains were later found beneath.
beats.label: DESTROYED 2014

beats.text: From Joppa to Nineveh to Spain, a long way to run.
beats.say: From JOP-ah to NIN-eh-vuh to Spain, a long way to run.

beats.text: Would you have gone to Nineveh, or run too?
beats.say: Would you have gone to NIN-eh-vuh, or run too?

youtube.title: Jonah Ran the Wrong Way 🗺️ #shorts
youtube.description:
Nineveh lay east. Jonah boarded a ship at Joppa for Tarshish, possibly Spain or Turkey.
The Hebrew says 'great fish', not whale. No outside record confirms his mission.
#Jonah #BibleHistory #Archaeology #MythUnearthed
